title: Throne of Eldraine: The Wildered Quest

entities.name: Rowan Kenrith
entities.description: A young warrior-mage twin who quests for her missing father the High King, and whose planeswalker spark ignites.

entities.name: Will Kenrith
entities.description: Rowan's twin, an ice mage who tries to befriend Garruk; shares her spark.

entities.name: Algenus Kenrith
entities.description: The High King of Eldraine and father of the twins, abducted by Oko and transformed into a stag.

entities.name: Oko
entities.description: A fey planeswalker who enslaves Garruk, abducts the High King and schemes to start a war between the Wilds and the Realm.

entities.name: Garruk Wildspeaker
entities.description: A planeswalker bewitched by Liliana's magic and Oko's mesmerism, later freed and redeemed.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A planeswalker whose corrupting magic runs through Garruk's veins.

entities.name: Queen Linden
entities.description: The High King's wife and stepmother of the twins, who revives Algenus's twins and later returns him to life.

entities.name: Cado
entities.description: The High King's trusted knight, whose griffin Hale Garruk kills.

entities.name: Titus
entities.description: A friend of the twins killed by a lich-lord.

entities.name: Cerise
entities.description: A friend of the twins who removes the hedron from Garruk's neck.

entities.name: Elowen
entities.description: A Vantress loremage who helps the party and is turned into a crested eagle by Oko.

entities.name: Hazel
entities.description: The twins' younger sister.

entities.name: Queen Ayara
entities.description: A queen who still partakes in the Wild Hunt but argues for peace; Oko impersonates her.

entities.name: King Yorvo
entities.description: The benevolent giant king of Garenbrig.

entities.name: Hale
entities.description: Cado's griffin, corrupted and killed by Garruk.

entities.name: Indrelon
entities.description: The magic mirror of Vantress that shows the twins the stag in the Wilds.

entities.name: Eldraine
entities.description: A plane blending Arthurian legend and Grimm fairy tales, with the Realm and the Wilds.

entities.name: The Wilds
entities.description: The enchanted wilderness of Eldraine that infringes on the courts.

entities.name: Wild Hunt
entities.description: The elven ritual hunt that Oko arranges to kill the stag and start a war.

entities.name: Chain Veil
entities.description: An artifact whose curse afflicts Garruk.

entities.name: Cauldron of Eternity
entities.description: A cauldron summoned by Will's persistence that lifts Garruk's curse and restores his life.

entities.name: Ardenvale
entities.description: The court whose griffin knights Queen Linden brings to the Wild Hunt.

events.summary: Oko arrives on Eldraine and is attacked and wounded by Garruk.
events.quote: The fey planeswalker Oko has just arrived on Eldraine when he is attacked and wounded by Garruk Wildspeaker .

events.summary: Oko traps Garruk in thorny vines and later mesmerizes him into a servile bodyguard.
events.quote: Oko mesmerizes him and turns him into a subservient bodyguard named

events.summary: High King Algenus prepares to leave on the Grand Procession.
events.quote: High King Algenus Kenrith is about to leave on the Grand Procession, his first-harvests tour of all five courts of the Realm.

events.summary: Oko and Garruk rescue the twins from redcaps in the Wilds.
events.quote: they are unexpectedly rescued by Oko and Garruk.

events.summary: Oko disguises himself as Cado and wipes the twins' memory of their encounter.
events.quote: He disguises himself as Cado and deletes the memory of their encounter in the twin's minds.
A bit later, he manages to abduct their father, the High King.

events.summary: Three months later Rowan and Will decide to quest for their father, joined by Titus and Cerise.
events.quote: Rowan and Will decide to start on a quest to find their father, and Titus and Cerise join them.

events.summary: Titus is killed by a lich-lord in the heartland of the Wilds.
events.quote: The rash Titus is first attacked by a drake and then killed by a lich-lord .

events.summary: Oko transforms Elowen into an eagle and traps the party in a thorn ring; Rowan realizes the stag is her father.
events.quote: So Oko changes Elowen into a crested eagle, which flies away, and traps the remaining company in a faerie ring of thorns and nettles.

events.summary: Cerise removes the hedron from Garruk, freeing his will but unleashing the Chain Veil's curse.
events.quote: While this has the desired effect of Garruk regaining his memories and his own will, it also returns the Chain Veil 's curse to its full force.

events.summary: Garruk corrupts and kills Cado's griffin Hale out of pity.
events.quote: Garruk corrupts Hale, Cado's griffin , and then kills it out of pity.

events.summary: Will's persistence summons the Cauldron of Eternity, which lifts Garruk's curse.
events.quote: Will's act of persistence summons the Cauldron of Eternity .

events.summary: At the Wild Hunt a figure looking like Queen Ayara mortally wounds the stag with an arrow.
events.quote: A brawl ensues, which ends with a person looking like Queen Ayara shooting the stag with an arrow and mortally wounding it.

events.summary: The murderer is revealed to be Oko in disguise, who planeswalks away.
events.quote: The murderer is revealed to be Oko in disguise.

events.summary: The dying stag transforms back into Algenus Kenrith.
events.quote: As it dies, it transforms back into the form of Algenus Kenrith.

events.summary: Flashback: Linden reveals the witch fed Algenus a love potion, and Algenus killed her.
events.quote: The witch had fed Algenus a love potion that had stolen his memory and his heart.

events.summary: Linden uses the sword's life to return Algenus to the living; Rowan's spark ignites and she and Will vanish.
events.quote: As there is still life in Algenus' sword from the well, Linden uses it to return him to the world of the living.

events.summary: Garruk pledges to find and protect the twins.
events.quote: Garruk pledges to find them and protect them.

relations.quote: The young warrior-mage twins Rowan and Will Kenrith quest for their missing father, the High King.
The young warrior-mage twins Rowan and Will Kenrith quest for their missing father, the High King.

relations.note: Linden revived him with a true love's kiss.
relations.quote: Linden had returned Algenus to his senses with a true love's kiss

relations.note: Oko mesmerized him into a subservient bodyguard.
relations.quote: Oko mesmerizes him and turns him into a subservient bodyguard named
A bit later, he manages to abduct their father, the High King.

relations.note: Cado is the High King's trusted knight companion.
relations.quote: with the High King in the lead and his trusted knight companion Cado at his side.

relations.note: Will tries to save Garruk and they find mutual trust.
relations.quote: Will tries to save the huge man despite the poor odds and at great risk to his own life.
